messages:
deploy-bot: Initiated micro-canary rollout: frontend-service v1.9.0 -> 1% traffic in eu-west-1. change-window 2026-03-21 14:00-14:30 UTC. Release notes: https://redwood.internal/releases/frontend/1.9.0

ellie: catching this on the SLO dashboard — small spike in 5xx and a handful of latency outliers. p99 ~520ms, baseline p99 ~180ms.

jose: I see 502 errors coming from the edge->gateway hop. Affected traces show `proxy: upstream reset` and a tiny increase in connection backlog. Could be a new keepalive/timeout default in v1.9.0.

mark: can we gate? prefer to pin staged cohort to v1.8.7 until we confirm. Also want to confirm there was no infra config change in front of the service.

ops-bot: Alert: frontend-service eu-west-1 error-rate > threshold (policy=SRV-5xx). Triggering incident channel.

ellie: +1 on pin. Tina can you run the stop/pin?

tina: executing pin now: ```/release pause service=frontend-service cohort=micro-canary version=v1.8.7 reason="502 spike"```.

deploy-bot: Micro-canary paused at 1%. Cohort routed back to v1.8.7. action_id=rl-4825678901-pause

ops-bot: Routing update confirmed. Traffic shift to stable version complete. Telemetry will reflect within 45s.

jose: after pin, error rate falling back toward baseline. Good signal. I'll collect the upstream proxy logs and check keepalive/timeout fields.

mark: next steps: 1) jose to triage logs and validate whether the reset is due to client->proxy or proxy->backend; 2) if it's config mismatch, revert infra config and unlatch v1.9.0; 3) if it's code, we cut a fix. Can we avoid full rollback yet? pin looks sufficient for now.

ellie: I'll append an entry to the change-window notes that we paused the micro-canary and pinned traffic. Also adding a follow-up slot at 15:00 UTC for a quick sync.

tina: assigning trace/triage ownership to @jose. Jose, ping here when you have the root cause or if you need a hotfix deploy.

jose: will update in 20-30m with findings. If it is the keepalive change we can ship v1.9.1 (hotfix) and re-run a 0.5% probe behind feature flag.

mark: notify @oncall-sre to monitor the window. If anything creeps above thresholds, enact full rollback.

oncall-sre: acknowledged. Monitoring channel added. ETA watching until 14:30 UTC.

ellie: thanks team. Keeping thread open for updates — will close after post-checks and notes updated. :white_check_mark:
